C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 226
Date 8/4/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

April 7th 191

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL JUNCTA JUVANT）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
The rebels are trying to organise a parliament
and they have wired to the provinces requesting them
to send two delegates each to Shanghai to discuss the
matter.
It is reported that General Yang has sent a
letter to the French Consul General saying that
the number of rebels who live in the western part
of French Town is increasing daily. The letter
requests the Consul General to devise some plan
to deal with them.
People residing in the vicinity of the
Arsenal are removing.
It is reported that as a result of
representations made by the Cantonese community
the China Merchants Steamship Co will refuse to
convoy the Government soldiers from Shanghai to
Canton.
A telegram was received yesterday at the
Arsenal from Peking saying that Yang and Loo
will be held responsible should trouble occur
in Shanghai.
It is reported that most of the Arsenal
detectives are now in pay of the rebels.

Your Obedient Servant,
[签名]
Chief of Detective Inspector.

[签名]
Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on M.S. Apl. 7

刑事调查处
情报官登记簿
第 226 号
日期：1916年4月8日

上海工部局。

191 年4月7日

（印章：上海工部局 同心协力）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

先生：

叛乱分子正试图组织议会，并已致电各省，要求各省各派两名代表来沪商讨此事。

据报，杨将军已致函法国总领事，称居住在法租界西区的叛乱分子人数日益增加。该信函请求总领事制定某些计划以处置他们。

居住在兵工厂附近的人们正在搬迁。

据报，由于广东籍社群提出交涉，轮船招商局将拒绝护送政府军从上海前往广州。

兵工厂昨日收到来自北京的一封电报，称若上海发生骚乱，杨与卢将被追究责任。

据报，兵工厂的大部分侦探目前正受雇于叛乱分子。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
侦探督察长。

[签名]
警务处总监。

录入于工部局档案，4月7日
